correctness.rationale: For every five positive lengths satisfying c4>1/2 and l3<c3, even maps have height c4, odd maps c3 and all slopes >1. Their five-by-five Perron operator collapses step densities after one iterate to (A,A,A,D,0), where T=[[1-q,d],[E,0]] and E=(l0+l2)/c4, d=l3/c3, q=Ed. Algebra yields eigenvalues 1,-q, normalized A*=1/(c3+E*l3), D*=EA*, hence exact alternating TV c3|A1-A*|q^(n-1), not an arbitrary BV mixing assertion. Primitive four-state adjacency M has Perron root (3+sqrt17)/2 and the step Markov invariant density proves physical ergodicity. KL divergence from the Parry transition gives strict metric entropy gap except on the four-active-branch equal-slope locus. Exact Fraction source CHECK.py inspected (91 geometries and 1001 step comparisons in its design). Separate rational geometry (1/10,1/5,1/5,1/10,2/5) yielded q=1/10, A*=20/11,D*=10/11, with eight-step recurrence verified exactly.

Parry and Lasota–Yorke establish general entropy/invariant measure theory; this claim is the explicit fixed-symbolic-entropy continuum of independently variable physical relaxation factors. Full 1990 maximal-ACIM criteria not accessible, so the slope-equality locus is not itself presented as a general novelty.
